title: Frankie Starlight
description: The quirky story of a young boy's adventures growing up with his stunningly beautiful mother and the two very different men who love her.

title: The Fourth War
description: Cold War adversaries Col. Jack Knowles and his Russian counterpart, Col. Valachev, are stationed on opposite sides of the German-Czech border. Both men are responsible for a group of troops in their remote settings, and both have been shaped by their combat experiences and a shared aversion to their superiors' ways of doing things. After a defector is killed, things escalate into a full-fledged battle with serious geopolitical ramifications.

title: Full Moon in Blue Water
description: Floyd, the owner of a bar on the Texas coast, has been depressed for a year after his wife disappeared in a swimming accident. He lives with his senile father-in-law "The General" and is helped by Jimmy, a former asylum inmate, and the good-natured Louise. The bar is rapidly losing money and Charlie wants to buy it cheaply before it becomes publicly known that a nearby bridge is to be built. Louise offers her savings to go into partnership with Floyd, but Floyd decides to sell when he is forced to pay his back taxes.

title: Frances
description: The true story of Frances Farmer's meteoric rise to fame in Hollywood and the tragic turn her life took when she was blacklisted.

title: Werewolf
description: After an archaeological team in Arizona unearths a werewolf skeleton and one of them develops symptoms of lycanthropy before dying, the dig's foreman, Yuri, tries to infect other townspeople as an experiment. When a science writer named Paul takes up residence in the town to cover the dig and develops a romantic interest in a female team member, Yuri makes Paul his next target.

title: Pirates of Sillicon Valley
description: Pirates of Silicon Valley is a 1999 American biographical drama television film starring Noah Wyle as Steve Jobs and Anthony Michael Hall as Bill Gates, chronicling the rise of Apple and Microsoft.

title: Secret in the Attic
description: A beautiful woman marries a wealthy man, who for years chose to be a bachelor inspite of numerous female suitors. At first the marriage is perfect; he’s a loving husband and an enthusiastic lover. But soon the romance cools and the wife discovers that it has to do with a secret kept in the attic, something – or someone – he visits every night, that is changing him from a loving husband into a stranger… Akira Fukamachi directs this erotic and atmospheric drama.

title: Recipe for Disaster
description: Rebecca Korda and her two brothers, Sam and Max, are left alone on opening night of their family-owned restaurant.

title: Good Boy
description: An intergalactic dog pilot from Sirius (the dog star), visits Earth to verify the rumors that dogs have failed to take over the planet.

title: J.R.R. Tolkien's The Hobbit
description: This short film is the first film adaptation of J.R.R. Tolkien's 1937 novel, The Hobbit. The film is a considered an "ashcan copy" as it was made quickly and cheaply by the producer to keep the rights to to the material.

title: Profile for Murder
description: A female police psychiatrist develops sexual fantasies involving a patient accused of murder.

title: French Twist
description: After learning of her husband's infidelities, a housewife invites an itinerant lesbian to move in with them. None of their lives will ever be the same again.

title: The Land of Faraway
description: Two Swedish boys (Nicholas Pickard, Christian Bale) fight a fantasy-land Black Knight (Christopher Lee) who has turned children into birds.

title: Overexposed
description: A soap-opera star (Catherine Oxenberg) thinks someone's trying to kill her, but cannot figure out which someone.

title: Honey, I Blew Up the Kids
description: Scatterbrained scientist Wayne Szalinski develops a contraption that makes objects bigger. A routine test goes horribly wrong, however, when Wayne accidentally targets his 2-year-old son with the enlarging ray. The toddler experiences huge growth spurts every time he is exposed to electricity. When their child grows to become over 100 feet tall, Wayne and his wife, Diane, must use a shrink ray to cure his gigantism before he destroys all of Las Vegas.

title: Faerie Tale Theater: The Princess & The Pea
description: A princess (Liza Minnelli) likes a lazy prince (Tom Conti) but is not so fond of his mother (Beatrice Straight); with Nancy Allen; directed by Tony Bill.

title: The Secret Life of an American Wife
description: Feeling restless after years of marriage and concerned that she's no longer attractive, housewife Victoria Layton (Anne Jackson) embarks on a quest to reaffirm her sex appeal. Victoria's husband, Tom (Patrick O'Neal), is a talent agent who represents a famous movie star (Walter Matthau) known for his womanizing ways, so she decides to take on the guise of a call girl to see if she can seduce the celebrity. Will she go through with bedding the actor, or will she remain faithful to her spouse?

title: A Summer to Remember
description: Toby is bitter since losing his hearing and refuses to accept his stepfather. But when an orangutan named Casey is thrown from a truck, the boy soon has a secret friend.

title: Hair
description: In New York City for the first time while on his way to enlist in the U.S. Army during the Vietnam War, Oklahoma farm hand Claude Hooper Bukowski (John Savage) meets up with a freewheeling group of Central Park hippies led by the irrepressible George Berger (Treat Williams). When the unlikely friends meet upper-middle-class debutante Sheila Franklin (Beverly D'Angelo), sparks fly between the country boy and the city girl, and Berger's troupe attempts to keep the young lovers together.

title: Rookie of the Year
description: A freak accident causes 12-year-old Little League player Henry (Thomas Ian Nicholas) to become such a powerful and accurate pitcher that the Chicago Cubs sign the junior high student to a contract. Unprepared for such a high-pressure environment, Henry falters until aging fast baller Chet Steadman (Gary Busey) takes him under his wing and teaches him how to play in the big leagues. Meanwhile, his mother's venal boyfriend (Bruce Altman) tries to sell Henry's contract to a hated opposing team.

title: My Life as a Fairytale
description: A wealthy patron and his daughter welcome the young Andersen into their home, and watch as his storytelling gifts flourish.

title: Heartsong
description: Heartsong is a unique musical experience in which you will share, with Dolly Parton, a lifetime of her Smoky Mountain inspiration.

title: Newsies
description: In this musical, homeless New York City newsboy Jack "Cowboy" Kelly (Christian Bale) befriends two newcomers to his trade, brothers David (David Moscow) and Les Jacobs (Luke Edwards). When publisher Joseph Pulitzer (Robert Duvall) sets new rules that make it harder for the young newspaper salesmen to make a buck, the boys go on strike. Bryan Denton (Bill Pullman), a journalist who's sympathetic to their plight, gives them some tips in public relations, as the newsboys' battle grips the city.

title: Rushmore
description: When a beautiful first-grade teacher (Olivia Williams) arrives at a prep school, she soon attracts the attention of an ambitious teenager named Max (Jason Schwartzman), who quickly falls in love with her. Max turns to the father (Bill Murray) of two of his schoolmates for advice on how to woo the teacher. However, the situation soon gets complicated when Max's new friend becomes involved with her, setting the two pals against one another in a war for her attention.

title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
description: A comedic send-up of the grim circumstances of the Middle Ages as told through the story of King Arthur and framed by a modern-day murder investigation. When the mythical king of the Britons leads his knights on a quest for the Holy Grail, they face a wide array of horrors, including a persistent Black Knight, a three-headed giant, a cadre of shrubbery-challenged knights, the perilous Castle Anthrax, a killer rabbit, a house of virgins, and a handful of rude Frenchmen.

title: Romeo & Juliet
description: In the Italian city of Verona, the Montague and the Capulet families are perpetually feuding. When Romeo (Leonard Whiting), a handsome young Montague, disregards convention by attending a Capulet ball, he falls in love with the beautiful Juliet (Olivia Hussey), a Capulet. After a brief courtship, the two elope, creating even greater tension between their families. Italian director Franco Zeffirelli's film is considered one of the best screen versions of Shakespeare's classic love story.

title: Dark Victory
description: Socialite Judith Traherne (Bette Davis) lives a lavish but emotionally empty life. Riding horses is one of her few joys, and her stable master (Humphrey Bogart) is secretly in love with her. Told she has a brain tumor by her doctor, Frederick Steele (George Brent), Judith becomes distraught. After she decides to have surgery to remove the tumor, Judith realizes she is in love with Dr. Steele, but more troubling medical news may sabotage her new relationship, and her second chance at life.

title: Garden State
description: After many years away, television bit part actor Andrew Largeman returns to his small hometown in New Jersey to attend his mother's funeral. There he is confronted by various aspects of the life he left behind, including his overbearing father. Largeman also meets compulsive liar and amateur musician Sam, with whom he feels an immediate connection. Together with several other figures from his past, Largeman heals old wounds and forges new friendships.

title: Little Women
description: In this 1994 adaptation of Louisa May Alcott's classic, the March sisters confront growing pains, financial shortages, family tragedies and romantic rivalries in mid-19th-century Massachusetts. Jo struggles for independence and sometimes clashes with her beloved mother and her sisters Meg, Amy and Beth. She also contends with their cranky Aunt March, their impulsive neighbor Laurie and kindly linguistics professor Friedrich Bhaer.

title: Little House on the Prairie: Christmas at Plum Creek
description: Christmas is coming and everyone is being secretive. Laura wants to buy something expensive for her mother and has to come up with a way to pay for it.

title: Picnic at Hanging Rock
description: In the early 1900s, Miranda (Anne Lambert) attends a girls boarding school in Australia. One Valentine's Day, the school's typically strict headmistress (Rachel Roberts) treats the girls to a picnic field trip to an unusual but scenic volcanic formation called Hanging Rock. Despite rules against it, Miranda and several other girls venture off. It's not until the end of the day that the faculty realizes the girls and one of the teachers (Vivean Gray) have disappeared mysteriously.

title: Fargo
description: "Fargo" is a reality-based crime drama set in Minnesota in 1987. Jerry Lundegaard (William H. Macy) is a car salesman in Minneapolis who has gotten himself into debt and is so desperate for money that he hires two thugs (Steve Buscemi), (Peter Stormare) to kidnap his own wife. Jerry will collect the ransom from her wealthy father (Harve Presnell), paying the thugs a small portion and keeping the rest to satisfy his debts. The scheme collapses when the thugs shoot a state trooper.

title: It's a Wonderful Life
description: George Bailey has so many problems he is thinking about ending it all - and it's Christmas! As the angels discuss George, we see his life in flashback. As George is about to jump from a bridge, he ends up rescuing his guardian angel, Clarence - who then shows George what his town would have looked like if it hadn't been for all his good deeds over the years.

title: Let's Make it Legal
description: A couple are divorcing because of his gambling after 20 years of marriage but are parting as friends. When an ex-flame starts making a play for her, hubby explains his lucky dice.

title: Sleepless in Seattle
description: After the death of his wife, Sam Baldwin (Tom Hanks) moves to Seattle with his son, Jonah (Ross Malinger). When Jonah calls in to a talk-radio program to find a new wife for his father, Sam grudgingly gets on the line to discuss his feelings. Annie Reed (Meg Ryan), a reporter in Baltimore, hears Sam speak and falls for him, even though she is engaged. Unsure where it will lead, she writes Sam a letter asking him to meet her at the Empire State Building on Valentine's Day.

title: Joan of Arc
description: During the Hundred Years' War, peasant girl Joan of Arc (Ingrid Bergman) hears voices instructing her to save France from the English. Convinced that these unsummoned murmurings are divine messages from God, Joan consults the uncrowned Charles VII (Jose Ferrer) who, startled by the accuracy of her clairvoyance, assembles an army and installs her as its leader and spiritual guide. Her victorious forces reclaim much of their homeland from the English, but she herself falls into enemy hands.

title: The Doom Generation
description: Teens Jordan White (James Duval) and Amy Blue (Rose McGowan) pick up a handsome drifter named Xavier Red (Johnathon Schaech). Red tends to create combustible situations -- for example, a trip to a convenience store leads to a clerk getting decapitated. Afterward, the trio voyages through small-town America, where Amy is accosted by various men claiming to be her lovers, and she and Jordan find themselves drawn to Xavier. But can any amount of sex lift the sense of doom hanging over them?

title: Sense and Sensibility
description: When Elinor Dashwood's father dies, her family's finances are crippled. After the Dashwoods move to a cottage in Devonshire, Elinor's sister Marianne is torn between the handsome John Willoughby and the older Colonel Brandon. Meanwhile, Elinor's romantic hopes with Edward Ferrars are hindered due to his prior engagement. Both Elinor and Marianne strive for love while the circumstances in their lives constantly change.

title: Terms of Endearment
description: Widow Aurora Greenway (Shirley MacLaine) and her daughter, Emma (Debra Winger), have a strong bond, but Emma marries teacher Flap Horton (Jeff Daniels) against her mother's wishes. When the marriage grows sour due to Flap's cheating, Emma eventually splits from him, returning to her mother, who is involved with a former astronaut (Jack Nicholson). Soon, Emma learns that she has terminal cancer. In the hospital, supported by Aurora, she tries to make peace with Flap and her children.

title: Fantasia
description: Disney's groundbreaking animated classic combines orchestral music with imaginative animated sequences, including the iconic "Sorcerer's Apprentice."

title: The Little Mermaid
description: Ariel, a young mermaid, dreams of life on land and makes a dangerous bargain with the sea witch Ursula to pursue her dreams.

title: Rear Window
description: A photographer confined to his apartment becomes convinced he's witnessed a murder while spying on his neighbors. Directed by Alfred Hitchcock and starring James Stewart and Grace Kelly.

title: Sixteen Candles
description: A teenager's sixteenth birthday is forgotten by her family as she navigates high school crushes, awkward moments, and growing up. Written and directed by John Hughes.

title: Wuthering Heights
description: Emily Brontë's classic tale of love, revenge, and obsession between Heathcliff and Catherine on the Yorkshire moors.

title: Frosty the Snowman
description: A magical snowman comes to life and embarks on a heartwarming adventure with a group of children before winter comes to an end. Narrated by Jimmy Durante.

title: While You Were Sleeping
description: A lonely transit worker is mistaken for the fiancée of a man in a coma and unexpectedly falls for his family—and his brother. Starring Sandra Bullock.

title: My Name is Barbara
description: Barbra Streisand's first television special features musical performances, comedy sketches, and the charisma that launched her television career.

title: High Fidelity
description: A record store owner reflects on his failed relationships while obsessing over music, mixtapes, and Top 5 lists. Starring John Cusack and based on Nick Hornby's novel.

title: A Beautiful Mind
description: The life of brilliant mathematician John Nash, whose groundbreaking work is complicated by his struggle with schizophrenia. Starring Russell Crowe.

title: You've Got Mail
description: Two business rivals unknowingly fall in love through anonymous emails, unaware they're battling each other in real life. Starring Tom Hanks and Meg Ryan.

title: Taxi Driver
description: A lonely Vietnam veteran working as a New York City taxi driver descends into obsession and violence as he attempts to "clean up" the city. Directed by Martin Scorsese and starring Robert De Niro.

title: Two Women
description: During World War II, a mother and daughter flee Rome seeking safety in the countryside, only to face the brutal realities of war. Starring Sophia Loren in her Academy Award-winning performance.

title: Almost Famous
description: A teenage aspiring music journalist goes on tour with an up-and-coming rock band in the 1970s, discovering the highs and lows of life on the road. Directed by Cameron Crowe.

title: Jesus Christ Superstar
description: Andrew Lloyd Webber and Tim Rice's rock opera retells the final days of Jesus through modern music and striking visuals.

title: How the Grinch Stole Christmas
description: The Grinch plans to ruin Christmas for the Whos of Whoville but discovers the true meaning of the holiday. Narrated by Boris Karloff.

title: Guys and Dolls
description: Two gamblers make a bet involving a Salvation Army missionary and a nightclub singer, leading to romance, colorful musical numbers, and classic Broadway charm. Starring Marlon Brando, Frank Sinatra, Jean Simmons, and Vivian Blaine.

title: Stardust Memories
description: Can a comedian evolve into a challenging artist? Not in the public's view, as Sandy Bates (Woody Allen) learns the hard way. The hostile comments persistently hurled at him indicate that audiences prefer his earlier slapstick comedies over his recent work: allegorical black-and-white head-scratchers in the vein of European art films. Invited to attend a retrospective of his work, the former funny man must come to terms with critics, audiences, lovers and, ultimately, himself.

title: Casablanca
description: During World War II, an American nightclub owner in Casablanca is forced to choose between rekindling a romance with his former love and helping her and her husband escape the Nazis. Widely regarded as one of Hollywood's greatest classic films, it blends romance, sacrifice, and political intrigue.

title: The Secret Garden
description: Young, orphaned Mary Lennox (Gennie James) leaves her residence in India to live with her uncle Archibald Craven (Derek Jacobi) at his lavish manor in Yorkshire, England. Ignored by her heartless uncle, Mary finds refugee in a hidden garden tended by a boy named Dickon Sowerby (Barret Oliver). One day, Mary is amazed to discover a miraculous power emanating from the garden, which begins to thaw long-withheld affections in the Craven household -- even healing Archibald's ailing son.

title: All Dogs go to Heaven
description: After returning from the afterlife, a lovable but mischievous dog sets out for revenge against his former partner but instead learns the value of friendship, kindness, and redemption through an orphan girl with a special gift.

title: Dances with Wolves
description: A Union Army lieutenant stationed on the American frontier befriends a Lakota Sioux tribe, finding a new sense of belonging while witnessing the clash between Native Americans and westward expansion.

title: Annie Hall
description: A neurotic New York comedian reflects on his relationship with the quirky and free-spirited Annie Hall, exploring love, memory, and the complexities of modern romance in Woody Allen's Oscar-winning classic.

title: The Witches of Salem
description: Set during the Salem witch trials, this historical drama follows the hysteria and fear that spread through a Puritan community as accusations of witchcraft tear families apart and innocent lives are destroyed. Based on Arthur Miller's The Crucible.

title: Apocalypse Now
description: During the Vietnam War, a U.S. Army captain is sent deep into the Cambodian jungle on a secret mission to find and eliminate a rogue colonel who has established his own mysterious and powerful command. A visually stunning and psychologically intense epic.

title: White Christmas
description: Two former Army buddies turned entertainers team up with a sister act to save a struggling Vermont inn by organizing a spectacular holiday show. Featuring classic songs by Irving Berlin, including "White Christmas."

title: Deconstructing Harry
description: A successful but troubled novelist finds his personal life unraveling as the people around him recognize themselves in his fictional stories. Woody Allen's dark comedy explores creativity, relationships, and self-reflection.

title: The Red Balloon
description: A young boy wandering the streets of Paris befriends a magical red balloon that seems to have a personality of its own. This beloved, nearly dialogue-free classic celebrates childhood imagination and friendship.

title: The Music Man
description: A charismatic traveling con man arrives in a small Midwestern town, convincing residents to start a boys' marching band despite knowing nothing about music. Along the way, he unexpectedly falls in love and begins to change his ways.

title: The Boys in then Band
description: A birthday party among a group of gay friends in New York City begins as a lively reunion but gradually turns into an emotionally charged evening as long-held resentments, insecurities, and truths come to the surface.

title: The X Files
description: FBI agents Mulder and Scully uncover a global conspiracy involving extraterrestrial life while investigating a deadly virus.

title: Pretty Woman
description: A wealthy businessman hires a spirited Hollywood escort to accompany him for a week, and their business arrangement unexpectedly turns into romance.

title: My Man Godfrey
description: A wealthy socialite hires a homeless man as her family's butler, only to discover he is far more sophisticated than anyone imagined in this classic screwball comedy.

title: Dune
description: Young nobleman Paul Atreides journeys to the desert planet Arrakis, where political intrigue, giant sandworms, and a valuable resource shape the fate of the galaxy. (If your VHS is the 1984 David Lynch version, this description applies.)

title: Dazed and Confused
description: On the last day of school in 1976, a group of Texas teenagers cruise, party, and search for freedom during one unforgettable night.

title: The Way We Were
description: Years after falling in love during college, a politically outspoken activist and an ambitious writer struggle to keep their relationship together as their differences grow in postwar America.

title: Best in Show
description: The tension is palpable, the excitement is mounting and the heady scent of competition is in the air as hundreds of eager contestants from across America prepare to take part in what is undoubtedly one of the greatest events of their lives -- the Mayflower Dog Show. The canine contestants and their owners are as wondrously diverse as the great country that has bred them.

title: Voodoo Apocalypse
description: An apocalyptic battle between a couple of cops and Papa Voodoo and his funk band.

title: New York, New York
description: Jimmy Doyle (Robert De Niro), an aspiring saxophone player, meets established USO band singer Francine Evans (Liza Minnelli) during V-J Day celebrations at the end of World War II. The two become a musical double act and, more importantly, fall in love. They quickly get married and start a family, however, their volatile relationship disintegrates over time. Years later, when both of them have successful careers, Jimmy and Francine find their paths crossing once again.

title: BMW Films Presents The Hire
description: The BMW film series The Hire consists of eight short films (averaging about ten minutes each) produced for internet distribution in 2001 and 2002.

title: Stoked The Rise and Fall of Gator
description: This documentary film explores the life of former skateboarding pro Mark "Gator" Rogowski, who, in 1991, was sentenced to 31 years in jail after raping and murdering a female acquaintance. Filmmaker Helen Stickler chronicles Rogowski's tragic journey from cool, confident skateboarding icon to convicted murderer. His struggles with alcoholism and depression are also explored, and skate legends such as Tony Hawk and Stacy Peralta offer first-hand accounts of their experiences with Rogowski.

title: Moonwalkers
description: In 60s London, an unstable CIA agent is forced to work with a shabby rock band manager to develop the biggest scam ever - to stage the moon landings. With or without the help of legendary filmmaker, Stanley Kubrick.

title: The Good The Bad The Ugly
description: In the Southwest during the Civil War, a mysterious stranger, Joe (Clint Eastwood), and a Mexican outlaw, Tuco (Eli Wallach), form an uneasy partnership -- Joe turns in the bandit for the reward money, then rescues him just as he is being hanged. When Joe's shot at the noose goes awry during one escapade, a furious Tuco tries to have him murdered. The men re-team abruptly, however, to beat out a sadistic criminal and the Union army and find $20,000 that a soldier has buried in the desert.

title: Digimon Adventure Reunion
description: It's been six years since that summer adventure when Taichi Yagami and the rest of the DigiDestined crossed over to the Digital World. And nearly three years have passed since the final battle between Hikari Yagami's group and BelialVamdemon. As the peaceful days passed by, at some point the gate to the Digital World closed. Not even the DigiDestined know what caused this, and time alone continues to pass.

title: Arizona
description: Cassie is a single mother and real estate agent whose problems go from bad to worse when a disgruntled client kidnaps her.

title: Where We Disappear
description: When Anastasia can take no more and kills her abusive husband, she is dragged away to face the horror of a Siberian gulag prison camp. Her arrival upsets the balance of power in the freezing cold shack she shares with the other inmates. They see her as weak and predict she will die within a week. With hostility and brutality all around her, Anastasia must fight to survive.

title: Loser
description: A kindhearted college student struggles to fit in at a new school while falling for a classmate who is already involved with someone else. Starring Jason Biggs.

title: The Wedding Planner
description: A successful wedding planner falls for the groom of one of her clients, forcing her to choose between her career and her feelings. Starring Jennifer Lopez and Matthew McConaughey.

title: National Lampoon's Senior Trip
description: A group of high school students takes a chaotic cross-country trip after their class paper criticizes the principal and lands them in trouble. Starring Matt Frewer and Jeremy Renner.

title: She Gets What She Wants
description: A popular Texas high school girl’s life is turned upside down when a charming French exchange student arrives and quickly becomes the new center of attention. A rivalry develops as the two compete for popularity, romance, and social status.

title: 40 Carats
description: A divorced woman begins a romance with a much younger man, challenging social expectations about age and relationships. Starring Liv Ullmann and Edward Albert.

title: The Fisher King
description: A disgraced radio shock jock seeks redemption by helping a homeless man searching for the Holy Grail. Starring Robin Williams and Jeff Bridges.

title: House Party 4
description: A group of friends tries to throw the ultimate house party while dealing with relationships, rivalries, and the chaos of young adulthood. A later entry in the House Party franchise.
